data.title: Your data, your decision
data.body: The data page explains what is stored, who can see it and how patients ask their clinic to change consent. It is public and needs no sign-in.

data.title: Your data, your decision
data.lede: Amal Family Clinic connects clinics so the next doctor can start informed. Nothing about you is shared between clinics unless you agree, and you can change your mind.
data.status: This page describes how Amal Family Clinic is designed to work. Sections marked Planned describe protections that are part of the design but are not yet active in this version.

noAnalytics.title: No doctor-performance analytics
noAnalytics.body: Amal Family Clinic does not rank, score or compare doctors. Patient records are never used to measure how a doctor performs.

stored.title: What is stored
stored.intro: Only what a clinic needs to look after you.

identity.d: Name, date of birth and phone number, so reception can find the right record.

appointments.d: Booked, arrived, completed or cancelled visits at a clinic.

clinical.d: What a doctor writes during a visit, including key alerts such as allergies.

consent.d: Which sharing level you chose, when, and who gave it if a guardian did.

account.d: Staff sign-in accounts and the reception devices registered to each clinic. No patient logs in.

audit.d: A record of who opened a patient record from another clinic, and when.

who.title: Who can see what
who.intro: Each role sees only what it needs. Your own clinic keeps the records it created for you.
who.n1: Reception coordinates appointments and never sees visit history or clinical notes.
who.n2: Basic consent shows a doctor the date, clinic and doctor of your other visits. Clinical consent adds notes and key alerts.
who.n3: Administrators manage clinics, users and devices. Administrative access is not clinical access.

none.d: Nothing is shared with other clinics.

basic.d: Other clinics' doctors can see when and where you were seen.

clinical.d: Doctors can also see visit notes and key alerts.

before.d: Until consent is recorded, no other clinic sees your records.

guardian.d: For a child or a person who cannot decide, a guardian gives consent and their name and relationship are recorded.

lite.d: Clinics using Lite mode keep their own records only and are not part of network sharing.

audit.title: Every cross-clinic look is recorded
audit.body: When a doctor opens your record from another clinic, the access is designed to be logged with the role, clinic and time, so your clinic can tell you who viewed it.

choices.title: Changing your mind

withdraw.d: Stops other clinics from seeing your records from their next request onward.

export.t: Get a copy of your data
export.d: Ask your clinic for a copy of the records it holds about you.

choices.unavailable: Not yet available online. Ask at your clinic.

how.d: Speak to reception at the clinic you visit, in person or by the phone number you already use for appointments. Staff record your request and the doctor or administrator handles it.

vsDelete.d: Withdrawing consent stops future sharing. It does not remove records your own clinic lawfully keeps about your care.

effect.d: Once a withdrawal is recorded, the design is that the next lookup from another clinic no longer shows your information.

data.foot: This page explains the design of Amal Family Clinic in plain language. It is not a legal statement.
